sloka: कुबेरेण स्वयं स्वप्ने स्वस्मै दत्तं महात्मना।दुर्जयं दुर्विषह्यं च सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ।। ६.९१.४८ ।।
transliteration: kubereṇa svayaṁ svapne svasmai dattaṁ mahātmanā।durjayaṁ durviṣahyaṁ ca sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ ।। 6.91.48 ।।

translations.english: Extraordinarily brilliant and of terrific valour, Lakshmana, perceiving the mighty shaft yoked by him (by Indrajith), he took up another arrow.
